newCurrentActionableFindings.title: Dipartimento della Funzione Pubblica · Tirocini InPA 2026
newCurrentActionableFindings.funding: Publicly financed programme supporting 190 curricular internships. The 2026 notice provides EUR 3,800 per internship in total support (EUR 3,600 trainee allowance plus EUR 200 to the university), subject to notice conditions.
newCurrentActionableFindings.eligibilityEvidence: The official InPA/DFP notice is addressed to public administrations under Article 1(2) of Legislative Decree 165/2001. Municipalities fall within that public-administration perimeter. Participating administrations must submit qualifying projects and operate through the required university agreement.

newCurrentActionableFindings.title: Dipartimento della Funzione Pubblica · Dottorati InPA 2026
newCurrentActionableFindings.funding: Publicly financed programme supporting 13 high-training/research apprenticeship contracts leading to a PhD. The official 2026 notice provides a gross annual amount of EUR 30,000 per contract for three years, subject to notice conditions.
newCurrentActionableFindings.eligibilityEvidence: The official InPA/DFP notice is addressed to public administrations under Article 1(2) of Legislative Decree 165/2001. The administration must submit a qualifying project and establish the required protocol with an accredited university.
newCurrentActionableFindings.evidenceCaveat: The attached Dottorati notice contains an apparent year typo in one deadline reference ('20 September 2025'). The authoritative 2026 DFP/InPA web pages and the 2026 lifecycle consistently state that applications are due by 20 September 2026.

newCurrentActionableFindings.title: MiC · Progetti speciali per il cinema e l'audiovisivo 2026
newCurrentActionableFindings.funding: Non-repayable contribution. The 2026 call has a EUR 4 million allocation; the contribution may cover up to 80% of eligible costs within the annual-call rules.
newCurrentActionableFindings.eligibilityEvidence: The official DG Cinema page lists public entities among beneficiaries and requires annual or multiannual initiatives/projects of particular national or international relevance and strong cultural, social and/or economic vocation in cinema and audiovisual.

newCurrentActionableFindings.title: ICSC · Sport Missione Comune 2026
newCurrentActionableFindings.funding: More than EUR 250 million in fixed-rate loan capacity plus EUR 42 million of interest-contribution resources. Eligible loans can receive full interest-rate abatement for the subsidised period, subject to the initiative rules.
newCurrentActionableFindings.eligibilityEvidence: The initiative is expressly addressed to municipalities and other territorial authorities and finances public sports-facility construction, expansion, renovation, energy-efficiency, completion/compliance, school-sport facilities, relevant acquisitions and cycle paths. Applications require the documentation specified by ICSC, including the favourable CONI opinion where required.

newCurrentActionableFindings.title: CINEA · Green Assist Project Advisory
newCurrentActionableFindings.funding: No cash grant. Free project advisory financed under the EU advisory framework; requests are normally submitted through the InvestEU Central Entry Point.
newCurrentActionableFindings.eligibilityEvidence: CINEA states that both public and private bodies may benefit. Green Assist normally focuses on a plausible investment programme of at least EUR 2.5 million, while smaller investments can be considered where replicable. The named Green Assist service is distinct from a generic InvestEU Advisory Hub reference because it has its own eligibility logic and delivery proposition.

waveConclusion: Wave 14 is not clean. Five new current actionable or rolling structural gaps were confirmed after canonical snapshot and prior-wave cross-check. The saturation counter remains 0/2. The discovery engine/config remains frozen. The next sweep can only move the gate to 1/2 if it is again full-corpus, independent and finds no new current actionable gap; a second consecutive clean full-corpus sweep would then be required to reach 2/2 and unlock hardening.
